title: 231. Unique Paths II

examples.explanation: There is one obstacle in the middle of the 3x3 grid above. There are two ways to reach the bottom-right corner: Right -> Right -> Down -> Down and Down -> Down -> Right -> Right.

hints: Use dynamic programming since, from each cell, you can move to the right or down.
Assume dp[i][j] is the number of unique paths to reach (i, j). dp[i][j] = dp[i][j - 1] + dp[i - 1][j]. Be careful when you encounter an obstacle; set its value in dp to 0.
